credits.title: Credits
credits.body: Built on Brock, with the Tessera design system for every screen and control.
home.title: Home
home.aside: A blank Brock app. Every file in src/screens is a screen.
controls.title: Controls
controls.body: A custom page: it keeps the {title} hub frame, nav, header and search, and draws its own content.
saves.title: Saves
saves.body: A page with header actions: New save opens the sub-page saves/new, and the filter is kept per page across restarts. Its menu entry sits under {title} in the title bar menu.
saves.new.title: New save
saves.new.name: Name
saves.new.unsaved: A new save has a name that is not saved.
storage.title: Storage
general.title: General
general.window.title: Window
general.windowMode.label: Window mode
general.windowMode.hint: Pick how the window sits on the screen. It changes right away.
general.windowMode.windowed.label: Windowed
general.windowMode.windowed.hint: A normal window you can move and resize.
general.windowMode.borderless.label: Borderless
general.windowMode.borderless.hint: Fills the screen without a frame, and other windows can still go on top.
general.windowMode.fullscreen.label: Fullscreen
general.windowMode.fullscreen.hint: Takes over the display until you leave fullscreen.
general.startFullscreen.label: Start fullscreen
general.startFullscreen.hint: On, the app opens fullscreen the next time it starts. The window you have now stays as it is.
general.widgetLayout.label: Widget layout
general.widgetLayout.description: Put the widgets back where they start.
general.widgetLayout.hint: Closes the widgets you opened and docks the others where the app first placed them.
general.audio.title: Audio
general.enableAudio.label: Audio
general.enableAudio.hint: Off mutes every sound the app plays, whatever the volume.
general.masterVolume.label: Master volume
general.masterVolume.hint: Drag to scale every sound at once. 100% plays them as made.
general.developer.title: Developer
general.developerTools.label: Developer tools
general.developerTools.hint: On, the menu shows the developer entries and the shortcut opens the browser developer tools.
general.debugLogging.label: Debug logging
general.debugLogging.description: Write debug lines to the session log.
general.debugLogging.hint: On, the session log keeps the detailed lines that help when you report a bug. The log grows faster.
tour.welcome.title: Welcome
tour.welcome.description: A short walk through the menu, the search, the Notes widget and the settings.
